text:
Daniel: FYI ACME (acct: acme-corp) opened a P2. They report API 403s on 2026-03-15 and claim audit logs are missing for 2026-03-14..16. Asking whether KMS/HSM rotation impacted logs and want a timeline + confirmation if any key material or customer ciphertext left HSMs. Support ticket #7241.

Ava: @Daniel can you paste the request IDs + any repro steps from the customer? Also need the exporter job IDs for that date range. :thinking: 

Daniel: Repro from ticket: curl against /v1/generate with acct token -> 403 consistently around 2026-03-15T03:12Z. Ticket includes request_id=tx_0a1b2c3d and export request ref export_ref=ex-7241.

audit-bot: export-job completed: job_id=1953210200, tenant=acme-corp, range=2026-03-14..2026-03-16, size_bytes=0, status=success (note: zero bytes)

Ava: I pulled HSM/KMS audit logs. Quick summary: no external key export calls recorded. Key rotation events: rk-001 rotated at 2026-03-14T03:12:18Z (internal rotation, by agent svc-keymgr). No unauthorized access entries. Snippet:
```
2026-03-14T03:12:18Z INFO keymgr rotate key=rk-001 actor=svc-keymgr request_id=rot-44b
2026-03-14T03:12:20Z INFO hsm access key=rk-001 actor=svc-keymgr op=seal
```

Ava: The zero-byte export is suspicious — exporter returned success but with 0 bytes between 03:10-03:40Z. Looking at exporter logs I see a transient DB connection error during that window; exporter retried and then re-ingested backlog at 1953210200 (the job above). The reingest populated the archive but the initial job produced 0 bytes which hit the support flow.

Daniel: Can you paste the exporter error lines? I need to attach to #7241.

Ava: Here are the lines: 
```
2026-03-15T03:10:05Z ERROR exporter write failed db: conn-refused
2026-03-15T03:10:35Z WARN exporter returning 0 bytes for range 2026-03-14..2026-03-16
2026-03-15T03:18:12Z INFO exporter retrying job job_id=1953210200
```

Priya: For customer comms — legal approval needed on wording. @Omar can you confirm we can say "no keys or key material left our HSMs" if Ava's audit is conclusive? We want to be explicit about timeline (what happened, when logs were reingested, and outage window). Need to deliver a timeline by EOD.

Omar: Based on Ava's logs we can state: (1) a transient exporter DB failure caused a zero-byte export between ~03:10-03:40Z, (2) a retry job completed and reingested the missing records at 1953210200, (3) HSM/KMS audit shows only internal rotate calls and no external exports. Draft language: "We identified a transient exporter issue that resulted in an empty audit export for the specified window. We reprocessed the backlog and confirmed, via HSM audit logs, that no key material left our HSMs." That should be OK.

Priya: Great — I'll draft and post to #7241, include the snippets and the job id. Suggest calling out the exact timestamps and that we proactively reprocessed.

Ava: Action items: I will attach the raw HSM audit lines + exporter logs to the support ticket and create an alert rule: exporter_zero_bytes > 1 for 15m -> pager. Also recommend adding a periodic verification job after rotations.

Daniel: I'll update the ticket and mark P2 -> customer notification needed. Priya, please share the draft before sending.

Priya: Draft ready, sharing in ticket comment now. 

audit-bot: incident-note created id=inc-1953210000 by Daniel at 1953210800

Daniel: Thanks team. I'll close the loop with the customer and ping here with their response. :thumbsup:
